edits.name: thornBed
edits.prompt: Repaint the first image as a bed of wicked sharp cave thorns growing from a low mound of dark grotto rock, seen exactly side-on, in exactly the hand-painted storybook style of the pieces in the second image: soft painterly gouache shading with gentle gradients, fine thin dark linework. The thorns are long, hooked and needle-sharp, pale bone white with cold blue shadows, each tip edged with a hot red-orange danger glow so they clearly read as dangerous against dark rock. The rock mound under them is dark cool grey-green grotto stone with a little moss. Keep its shape and size. Keep the flat plain grey background around it, with empty grey space on every side.
